title: Review Migrant Domestic Worker Hiring Policies to Allow Diverse Care Arrangements such as Private Co-Living Care Format
what_it_is: Review Migrant Domestic Worker Hiring Policies to Allow Diverse Care Arrangements such as Private Co-Living Care Format

sections.label: MDW employment protection under EFMA
sections.summary: MDWs are protected under the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act, which sets employer obligations and limits their work to non-commercial domestic services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Employment protection policies designed for MDWs are premised on the MDW providing only non-commercial domestic services to her employer's household at the employer's place of residence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To take into account the flexibility around work hours and rest patterns that may be needed for their nature of work, MDWs are not covered by the Employment Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MDWs are instead protected under the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act (EFMA).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To protect the well-being of MDWs, the scope of domestic work and the employment of MDWs are tightly circumscribed under the EFMA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: An employer has obligations under the EFMA in ensuring the safety and well-being of the MDW, providing adequate food and rest time, paying their salary on time and covering the MDW's medical expenses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The balancing of flexibilities in employment rules for the care of the elderly should not result in the delegating of the primary responsibilities of the employer in the EFMA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For example, MOM cannot allow MDWs to be deployed in a business operation that could subject MDWs to overwork.

sections.label: MOM MOH elderly care models
sections.summary: MOM is working with MOH to develop new care models for the elderly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: In fact, MOM is working with MOH to develop new care models for the elderly.
